query: computer science, 2020, sigchi, karola marky, 3d auth two factor authentication with personalized 3d printed items
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE
  p.year = 2020
  AND LOWER(p.canonical_venue) IN ('chi', 'sigchi')
  AND LOWER(a.name) LIKE '%karola%marky%'
  AND (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, ''))
      @@ plainto_tsquery('english',
        '3d & (auth | authentication) & (two & factor | 2fa) & personalized & printed'
      )
    OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%3d auth%'
    OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%3d authentication%'
    OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%two factor%'
    OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%2fa%'
    OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%3d printed%'
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')),
    plainto_tsquery('english',
      '3d & (auth | authentication) & (two & factor | 2fa) & personalized & printed'
